value: A calm, dense interface people can look at all day: greyscale first, hairlines instead of shadows, one primary action per page, and a checklist to review a diff or a screenshot against.

howItWorks.title: Values come from the tokens; this skill decides where each one goes

workflow: Load ui-design-tokens alongside it; every value comes from there.
Lay out the page with its rules: hairline panels, few weights, spacing from the scale.
Give each page one primary action and quiet secondary ones.
Run the style checklist on the diff or a screenshot before review.

inAction.caption: Our skill catalog before and after its rules: 42 separate cards became one panel with ruled rows, tags became small quiet chips. The catalog is not an app screen, so only the rules that fit a public page were applied.
inAction.source: skillforgecloud.com, before: live site; after: design-tokens branch of skill-forge-site, 2026-11-28

image.alt: Skill Forge catalog page, 42 separate cards on the left and one ruled list on the right
